positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	As technical lead, parallelize key monolithic Java application subsystem, improving application throughput by as much as 75%.

•	Identify areas for SQL query and database schema optimization by leveraging database analysis tools, improving query response time for business critical functions by as much as 90%.

•	Proactively liaise with business-facing stakeholders to translate business requirements for key projects and customer change requests into actionable, prioritized technical deliverables.

•	Mentor team members by way of technical design assistance, code reviews, and ongoing technical and application knowledge transfer to improve team capacity. 

•	Provide third tier application support for production services team to triage production issues.
positions.insights: Query Optimization, IntelliJ IDEA and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop business-critical web-based Java application features for multiple high-profile clients utilizing Hibernate, EJB, JQuery/JavaScript, and Velocity.

•	As technical design lead for several projects, craft design documentation in collaboration with other development teams to provide technical direction.

•	As interim scrum master, lead a team of 10+ engineers to deliver demonstrable features for multiple projects concurrently, planning sprints amidst a tide of changing client priorities and production issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and support multiple web-facing Java applications in a robust technology environment utilizing Spring, Struts 2, Hibernate, Apache Tiles, JSTL, JSP, JQuery/JavaScript, and Hadoop.

•	Support JBoss application server infrastructure upgrade to improve application performance.

•	Provide second tier application support for client services team to investigate production issues and customer inquiries.

positions.title: Director, Systems Services Support
positions.description:
•	Oversaw all aspects of the software development life cycle, concurrently managing multiple project teams spanning the globe, to produce on-time, on-budget, mission-critical, multi-tier trading system software applications leveraging Java, SQL, and XML technologies.

•	Ensured software and data quality of 24/7 multi-tier trading applications processing more than 1 million transactions daily.

•	Liaised with key business partners and technical leads, providing clarity and technical subject matter expertise on all major software development projects.

•	Implemented 4-month global training program to augment team capacity and improve application support for round-the-clock development and support of trading system software.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Manager
positions.description:
•	Defined project scope and estimation processes for teams of 60 resources successfully delivering 50 key projects annually amidst continuously evolving regulatory and business requirements.

•	Established a software change awareness forum to streamline the implementation of applications in a complex environment comprised of dozens of servers to ensure seamless business processing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	In a lead role, authored technical and design specifications in support of multi-tier applications comprised of nearly 1 million lines of code to produce on-time, stable software.  

•	Created ad-hoc software development tools for the project team to increase development productivity and testing capabilities, thereby enhancing software quality.

positions.title: Systems Architect
positions.description: •	Defined long-term strategy for application infrastructure to reduce costs.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
•	Oversaw the technical design and support of a highly complex software system to deliver new functionality and stability to more than 100 clients.

•	Launched and instructed an international client training program, thereby increasing end user software application knowledge and awareness.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: •	Developed enhancements and supported the margin processing software application to address evolving regulatory and client requirements.
